posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Until you find a solution, you can use the mouse wheel to change the selection on drop down menus and you can hit the space bar to edit event commands.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
either your display driver or its settings seem to be damaged.
I suggest you go to the display chip's manufacturer's website (usually AMD, nVidia or Intel) and download the latest driver setup and run that to see if that is enough to solve the problem.
Do NOT use the built-in Windows functions, it needs to be the setup from the website.
Because the Windows automatics tend to keep the damaged current driver in such cases.
